nodes.text:
-------------------------------
|          CHAPTER 15          |
-------------------------------


Nobody speaks for a moment.##

Theo is looking at you with his brow very slightly furrowed,
which on Theo is the equivalent of a dropped jaw.#
Smiurl has crept out from behind Corolla
and is staring at you from roughly the height of your knee,
his skin running through small rapid pulses of uncertain orange.##

Efeliah says nothing.# She already knows.##

From the floor, a sound.# And then Corolla shifts, her hand moving first,
fingers pressing flat against the ground.##

$m"She will be all right,"$C# Math says quietly, his eyes not leaving you.#
$m"It is a superficial burn.# We have already contained the pain."$C##

You look at her, and believe him.##

Smiurl's skin flushes, slowly, into a relieved and luminous gold.##

Theo puts one hand briefly on Math's shoulder as he passes, crouching beside Corolla.#
No words.# Theo does not need words for this.##

nodes.recap: RAW MATERIAL moved verbatim from c14 under issue 7 - rewrite under issue 8 (source ch. XIV-XV). Was c14 node 10: Riff arrives - victory

dialogues.precomment:
You hear people rushing in.#
Riff enters at a run, followed by three of his fighters,
all of them bloodied and out of breath and grinning
with the uncontrollable, bewildered relief of people
who had stopped expecting to win.##

He takes in the room: the darkened Projector, the machine at rest,
Math and Efeliah on their feet, and Corolla sitting upright against the wall,
pale but conscious, her eyes sharp.##

His jaw moves, but no sound comes out.

You look around the room, at your companions,
at the machine that has held a city captive for years, now dark and silent.
dialogues.comment:
Riff looks at them.# He puts his fist against his chest and bows his head.#
A brief gesture, but it carries everything.##

dialogues.line:
'Mayor' Joe is gone.# Slipped out a side passage before we reached the top.#
We will find him.# Ayonn will find him.# That is not your problem.#
You have done what we could not do ourselves.
dialogues.comment:
He straightens.#
The grief-lines in his face have not gone anywhere,
but something behind his eyes is different, lighter.

dialogues.line:
The city will need time.# Months, probably.#
People waking up, people remembering, people finding out
what happened to the ones who never came back.#
That will not be easy.
No.# But the city will be theirs again, and that will make all the difference.
dialogues.comment: Riff looks at her for a long moment.# He nods.

dialogues.line: Where do you go from here?

dialogues.comment: You simply say. #The others nod in agreement.

nodes.recap: RAW MATERIAL moved verbatim from c14 under issue 7 - rewrite under issue 8 (source ch. XIV-XV). Was c14 node 11: farewell to Riff, departure from Ayonn - gathering in the atrium before dawn
nodes.text:
They give you provisions: water, dried food, a better map than anything
you have carried before.# Toward the third hour of the night
you gather in the great municipal atrium to say your goodbyes.##

Ayonn is changed.##

Not the buildings, not the streets, which are the same gray and concrete
they always were, but the people are different, and you see it in every one you pass:
guards sitting against walls with their headbands removed, staring at their hands,#
civilians emerging from doorways, blinking, uncertain, as if waking
from a long sleep they did not choose and cannot quite place.#
Small knots of people finding each other, arms around shoulders,
the kind of stillness that comes just before someone starts to cry.

nodes.recap: RAW MATERIAL moved verbatim from c14 under issue 7 - rewrite under issue 8 (source ch. XIV-XV). Was c14 node 110: farewell to Riff and Math - Math stays to mind the Projector

dialogues.precomment:
Riff embraces each of you in turn, longer than expected,
and with the unconcealed emotion of someone who has decided
this is not the moment for composure.
dialogues.line:
Friends.# I hope we meet again, one day.#
I cannot yet take in everything you have done for all of us.#
It happened too fast.# Thank you.# Thank you again.
dialogues.comment:
He holds on for a moment longer than is strictly necessary.##

Then Math steps forward.

dialogues.precomment:
Math's expression is composed, as always, though something behind his eyes
is doing something quiet and considered.
dialogues.line:
I wish you good luck.# If the Master predicted your arrival,
then your destiny is sealed.# I am certain we will meet again.
dialogues.comment: He says it with the calm certainty of someone quoting a principle they have tested and found holds.

dialogues.line: We'll stay in contact with you through the amplifier, won't we?

Of course.# I'll make myself heard often.##

I don't want to hold you too long: too much sentiment now
could cause hesitation, and that is the last thing you need.
dialogues.comment: He glances over his shoulder toward the Projector room above.# Then, as if remembering:

dialogues.line:
The Projector has been reactivated, but your minds
will be ignored by the machine.# Do not worry about it.
dialogues.comment:
He accompanies you to the door.#
At the threshold he stops, and you understand without being told
that this is where he stays.##

dialogues.precomment:
You look at him: the scholar from Seer's Rock,
the man who opened the psychic door.
dialogues.comment:
He nods once.# Something in his expression closes into the
particular stillness of a man who finds it better not to speak.

nodes.text:
You set off along the main street just before dawn,
leaving the Municipal building behind, and Ayonn with it.#
You pass through the south gate while a gap is opened in the holographic shield,
and the guard on duty raises a hand as you step out,
and the moment your feet leave the city perimeter the shield closes
and takes its shape again behind you.##

You walk a few hundred meters and turn to look at it.#
From out here, without the dread the machine once projected, it is simply beautiful,
a hemisphere of shifting light sitting over the city like a second dawn.##

$c<<The hemispheric glory of Ayonn.>>$C#
$C$c<<I could not forget a place like this, even if I tried.>>$C##

$C"$cAnd come to think of it,"$C# you say aloud,
surprising yourself, $c"I could not forget any of the rest, either."$C##

$CThey look at you.# Then they turn back to the road.

nodes.text:
Smiurl walks between Corolla and Theo, his skin cycling
through slow, warm colors: amber, rose, a satisfied cream.#
Corolla walks steadily, a little stiffly, the burn on her back a reminder
she is not going to dwell on.# Efeliah walks in silence,
her eyes already moving south.##

You walk.##

$c<<South.>>#$C

That is what you know.# That is what the machine told you,
or what something through the... machine? told you,# and you are
not going to examine it too closely right now.##

Ahead: the road, and whatever comes next.##
